scope: Work planning from shipped interfaces and the current native implementation. Declaration inventory is not implementation coverage. Complete semantic review of all declarations, inherited/imported APIs, lifecycle effects and all supported platforms remains open. No module status is promoted by this audit.
source_notice: Extracted declarations retain PascalABC.NET source authorship: Ivan Bondarev, Stanislav Mikhalkovich; see ../../doc/copyright.txt and ../../doc/license.txt. These audit files and development tools are not installed with the application.
counting_rules: Count declarations, not distinct names: overloads, forward type declarations and preprocessor branches remain separate.
Exposed means module-level, public or protected declarations; hidden compiler helper exports remain included.
Type aliases do not enumerate the APIs of their targets. Fields, constants and variables are counted separately from callables/properties.
Missing methods cannot be inferred from declaration names alone. Every callable/property starts unreviewed.
The required-case corpus deliberately includes known gaps. Its pass ratio is not a progress estimate or full module coverage.

modules.name: FilesOperations

reviewed_exports.name: ReadFileToEnd
reviewed_exports.required_semantics: Text reset, read each logical line and append the host newline, including the unterminated final line; BOM/default codec; close on normal completion.

reviewed_exports.name: WriteStringToFile
reviewed_exports.required_semantics: Text rewrite and Write(Text,object); nil string writes nil as text; preserve embedded line endings and close on normal completion.

modules.new_evidence: Independent .NET 10.0.12 outcomes cover 2198 complete reads, 238 complete writes, 2023 direct decoding cases and 42 Windows sharing combinations. Native recovery checks cover repeated failed opens, cancellation, bounded work and reopening. Incomplete configured UTF-32LE preamble fallback corrected in the shared decoder.
remaining_gates: Full dependency/code-page coverage beyond the seven implemented encodings, and platform-specific sharing/error compatibility on Linux/macOS, remain open.
Review the remaining common Text/path/encoding API and execution-resource policies for both routines; source-unit interoperability is still incomplete.
modules.next_action: Extend dependency coverage and platform-specific sharing/error evidence; the independent complete-routine recipes now provide a regression gate for the seven current encodings.

modules.name: IniFile
remaining_gates: Native TIniFile is a closed special type: class inheritance and inherited Object members are incomplete. Required positive cases now reproduce inheritance, ToString, Equals and GetHashCode failures.
GetType is available, but System.Type.Name is not; selected positive cases separate these two facts.
SortedList current-culture semantics are only covered by the en-US native profile; mutable culture, inherited/imported APIs and full platform error/sharing parity need review.
IndexOfSection, IndexOfIdent, fname and sl are private in the original class; they must not be added as missing public exports.
modules.next_action: Implement required common class/Object foundations and file compatibility, rather than invent additional IniFile exports.

modules.name: Arrays
modules.new_evidence: Closed explicit calls and typed procedure values for seven generic declarations, backed by native/tests/array_generics_tests.cpp and 720 independent .NET 10 outcomes. Generic real matrix output uses general formatting; the nongeneric real overload retains precision. Exact full delegate parameter counts are confirmed by the original converter source.
remaining_gates: Explicit closed calls and typed procedure values for the seven generic declarations now use the existing native element/formatting profiles. The original ampersand syntax is retained; the required Arrays.FillByValue&<integer>(a,1) case now passes. Class output, general generic source routines and complete generic type interoperability remain open.
Complete per-overload review of type constraints, defaults, nil/error paths and generic element behavior; declared generic T ranges over more types than the native type system currently implements.
Source-unit interoperability and platform compatibility remain unproven. User comparison interfaces have been ported and must not remain listed as wholly absent.
modules.next_action: Continue the per-overload/type review of all 29 declarations, including source-unit, covariance and class/formatting foundations; explicit closed generic procedure binding now has independent regression evidence.

modules.name: PABCSystem
remaining_gates: Full individual semantic review of 1157 callable/property declarations, including compiler helpers and private members, plus all type aliases, fields, constants, variables and lifecycle effects.

Positive native checks demonstrate missing Object, decimal, DateTime, Complex, ShortString, sorted collections, collection interfaces, StringBuilder and NumberFormatInfo. This is a selected list, not the full remaining API.
Aliased imported types expose APIs beyond the declaration baseline; full boxing, inheritance, overrides, exceptions, generic source routines and source-unit loading must be audited and implemented.
Full Windows/Linux/macOS behavior and portable Qt GUI deployment are not established by passing native core checks.
modules.next_action: Create per-declaration evidence and implement shared language/type foundations needed by whole source units; retain the full bin/Lib scope.
